author: Smoebo
generator: Grok Build command-line tool 1.0.60, image_gen, one call per plate with the prompt recorded here unchanged
subjectBasis: Original designs for entries of the post-apocalyptic bestiary (src/lib/bestiary/post-apocalyptic.json), per docs/art/creature-art-guidance.md: its people, its machines and the creatures whose fantasy plate was the wrong picture. Uniforms are of invented armies. No published illustration, film character or real person was named or supplied as an input.
encoding: Each 1024x1024 JPEG original resized once to 256x256 (cover) and encoded once to WebP quality 75 with sharp.
review: Each shipped plate was viewed at full size and in a round crop at 96px and 40px on dark and light surrounds. Six are second paintings. The dead commander and the junta trooper first came back in uniforms that read as a historical army's, and were repainted as an invented one. The three shelter medics first wore a red cross, a protected emblem, and now wear a green first-aid cross. The neutral old soldier read as a man until the second prompt covered the face. The Blood Baron is painted as the person the card presents; a painting of what he is was made for the reveal feature and ships with it.
